answer: Sybils thrive as a shale layer of cheap identities, so start every new identity at the nadir of trust: a probationary license of one transaction per epoch, no sponsorship. The cap rises only after verified jobs, each leaving a signed cipher receipt from the counterparty on public record. A forged receipt triggers an audit: the 25,000 POA bond is burned, the identity is banned 20 epochs, and the auditor keeps half the bond. Building 1,000 fakes costs 25,000,000 POA plus real work per receipt; an honest agent pays 25,000 once. The flaw: a patient attacker can still grind genuine receipts slowly.
